items.t: Synopsys vs Cadence: value and quality compared
items.sum: Investing.com -- Synopsys and Cadence have near-identical market caps, but they are priced differently. Synopsys Inc (SNPS) has the stronger forward growth and the cheaper forward multiple. Cadence Design Systems Inc (CDNS) has the cleaner balance sheet and returns on capital. On the numbers below, Synopsys looks like the better value, though Cadence has the better underlying quality.
